gene_selection: Ten nearest distinct annotated gene symbols per declared region anchor plus predeclared candidate/marker genes; not expression-selected
methods: Median/range CPM across three reported replicate labels; within-label log2 ratios only when both values positive; no pseudocount or inferential testing
limitations: Source/tissue fields in GEO may contradict specific sample title/treatment; titles/characteristics used and conflict preserved
No independent individual donor identity verification beyond biological replicate labels
Processed CPM is not raw count input for DESeq2
No local ATAC or post-integration safety inference
Transcript annotation and gene symbols differ between CanFam3.1 expression processing and ROS genomic context; missing symbols not zero
